generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

The bidder is required to ensure browser compatibility of the computer well in advance to the last date and time for receipt of tenders. The departments shall not be responsible for non-accessibility of e-Procurement portal due to internet connectivity issues and technical glitches at bidders end.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidder shall pay Contract Management Module non refundable processing fees of 0.025% of the contact value (Min Rs.500/- & Max Rs.7500/-)
Conditional tenders will not be accepted
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
Contractors Should be registered with KPWD as Class-3 and above Contractor.
Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt orders.
All the formats prescribed in the bid document shall be filled by the tenderer in complete manner otherwise it will be rejected
All scanned documents to be uploaded shall be in original and the Executive Engineer reserves the right to verify the documents before approval.
The employer reserves the rights to Reject or accept any or all the tenders without assigning any reasons.

The intending contractors are requested to note that they should abide by the detailed instructions and conditions contained in the Standard Tender documents KW-3 K.P.W.D. and further orders there on.

In the case of the death of the contractor after executing the agreement commencement of the work, his legal heir, if is an eligible registered contractor and is willing can execute and complete the work at the accepted tender rates irrespective of the cost of the work
Contractor should carry out additional test required to test the suitability of materials.
The defect liability period for this project shall be 1 year

The successful Tenderer shall deliver to the Employer a Security deposit in any of the forms given Clause 29.1 of ITT for an amount equivalent to 5% of the Contract price plus additional security for unbalanced tenders in accordance with Clause 25.5 & 29.1 of ITT and Clause 44 of the Conditions of Contract. This shall released after DLP.

Contractor should take all precautions to ensure that no damage is caused to any adjacent structures/utilities above or below the ground and also to the existing canal CD works and other similar structures which have been constructed by other agencies during project execution. If any damage is caused, it has to be rectified at his own risk and cost.

All safety precautions, warning signs, night illumination, reflectors, deployment of security guards has to be ensured so that no untoward incident happens on account of negligence or any project activity. Contractor should indemnify the client to that extent.
Formation levels and other data furnished are bare minimum the contractor should make all efforts to validate and to get additional data if required at his own cost.
Contractor should execute the project with least impact to the environment till the completion of project.

further particulars if any, required by the Contractor can be had from the office of the Executive Engineer, PWD, Ramanagara Division, Bengaluru south district during office hours on all working days.

all materials required for the work like bitumen, steel, cement etc., shall be procured by the tenderer themselves and should got tested by the quality assurance, PWD before use on the work at their own cost.

The contractors assessed available tender capacity will be calculated as per the clause 3.6 of standard tender document Attached. For calculation of tender capacity A and B values must be furnished work wise duly signed by the authorized signatory.

All the items in the tender including all lead, lifts,loading unloading, transportation, labour, hire charges of machinery curing for concrete works, cost and convence of all matiral and all other such incidental charges necessary for successful completion of works as per the detalied technical specification and direction of Engineer-in-charge of this work

When embankments are constructed disputes arising on account of damages to the existing field channels, bunds and other private properties, if any, has to be resolved by the contractor. All precautions should be taken by the contractor so that there are no damages to such public/ private properties.
Contractor should take all precautionary measures to avoid any damage to the utilities during excavation as well as utility shifting. To that extent the contractor should indemnify the client.
Contractor should follow strictly the prevailing rules of labour act & The contractor should employ only registered labours as per Govt. Circular No. PWD/198/BMS/2009/ Dated: 24-06-2009
The increase in GST shall not be paid in the extended period of contract for which the contractor alone is responsible for delay as determined by the authority while granting the extension of time.
GST Shall be paid to the tendered amount separately

Royalty on construction materials and other taxes will be deducted as per prevailing Govt. orders. As per Karnataka state Government order LD/300/LET/2006 Bangalore dated 01.01.2007 and Government letter no PW/134/ BMS/2007 dated 27.07.2007, a sum amounting to 1% of the bill amount will be deducted towards constructions labour welfare fund.

The scanned copy of Bank Gurantee as prescribed in standard the Bid document to be uploaded and the original BG to be submitted on or before the last date of receipt of tender to the Executive Engineer, PWD, ramanagara Division
The successful tenderer should provide monthly physical and financial progress to be achieved in Bar chart/Milestone chart/PERT chart during agreement.

Contractor should adhere to EMS (environmental monitoring system)and safety health and environmental (SHE) policy applicable for similar projects. Contractor to that extent should submit EMS document defining all the procedure including the policies before execution of the project

The tenderer shall be solely responsible for the safety of their staff and the general public on the site and shall observe all the precautionary and safety measures through the execution of the work.
All the concrete items are inclusive of form work

technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed as prime contractor at-least one such similar concrete road work of value not less than Rs.34.70 lakhs (50% of estimated cost of tender)

Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work (1)Earth work /embankment/subgrade-349.00 Cum 2) RCC/PCC- 125.00 cum 3)CC Pavement-315 Cum 4)WMM/GSB-335.00 cum 5)TMT Steel-4.08 tonne) (80% of peak rate of construction)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year-not applicable

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year-not applicable
Each Tenderer should further demonstrate the following Availability by owning/Hiring/lease required key and critical equipment for this work as specified below-NOT APPLICABLE
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted

Assessed available tender capacity - (AxNx2.5-B) where A -Maximum value of civil engineering works executed in any one year during the last five years (updated to current financial year price level)(FY in which tenders are invited) taking into account the completed as well as works in progress. N - Number of years prescribed for completion of the works for which tenders are invited. B Value, at Current Financial year (FY in which tenders are invited) price level, of existing commitments and on-going works to be completed during the next 03 Months. (Period of completion of the works for which tenders are invited
Qualification and experience of the key technical and management personnel in permanent employment with the tenderer and those that are proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditors reports for the last five years

Achieved in at least two financial years an average annual financial turnover for last 5 years (2021-22 to 2025-26) (civil engineering construction works) of Rs.69.40 Lakhs issued by CA With UDIN number along with balance sheets mandatory

itemList.description: Clearing    and    grubbing    road    land    including    uprooting    rank vegetation,  grass,  bushes,  shrubs,  saplings  and  trees  girth  up  to 300  mm,  removal  of  stumps  of  trees  cut  earlier  and  disposal  of unserviceable  materials  and  stacking  of  serviceable  material  to be used or auctioned,  including removal and disposal of top organic soil not exceeding 150 mm in thickness. By Mechanical Means using Dozer - In area of light jungle ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

itemList.description: Scarifying  Existing  Granular  Surface  to  a  Depth  of  50  mm  by Mechanical Means using Hydraulic excavator. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305.4.3 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -3- EARTH WORK, EROSION CONTROL AND DRAINAGE
itemList.description: Construction of Subgrade and Earthen Shoulders - Construction of sub-grade and earthen shoulders with approved material   obtained   from   borrow   pits   with   all   lifts   &   leads, transporting  to  site,  spreading,  grading  to  required  slope  and compacted to meet requirement of table No. 300-2. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 305 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

itemList.categoryName: Vol - 3 -Chapter -4- SUB-BASES, BASES (NON-BITUMINOUS), SHOULDERS AND STABILIZATION METHODS
itemList.description: Wet Mix Macadam (Plant Mix Method) - Providing,   laying,   spreading   and   compacting   graded   stone aggregate to wet mix macadam specification including premixing the Material with water at OMC in mechanical mix plant carriage of mixed Material by tipper to site, laying in uniform layers with paver/grader in sub-base / base course on well prepared surface and compacting with vibratory rollerto achieve the desireddensity. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 406 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

Mechanical Means -
Earth work excavation for Foundation by mechanical means  for all   works   & depth upto 3 m, as per drawing and technical  specifications, including setting out,     shoring,  strutting,  barricading,  caution  lights,     including  dressing  of excavated  surfaces,  disposing  off  or  levelling  the  excavated  earth  or  sorting &   stacking the selected   earth for reuse in a radius of   50 m and lift upto 1.5 m  including  cost  of  labour,  tools,  usage  of  machinery  &  other  appurtenaces required to complete the work. In all kinds of soils  Depth upto 3 m ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete  for  levelling  course  for all  works  in  foundation.  The    granite/trap/basalt    crushed  graded  coarse aggregates  and fine aggregates  as per relevant IS Codes machine mixed, laid in layers not exceeding 150 mm thickness, well compacted using plate vibrators, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing,  and all the other  appurtenances  required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - Mix 1:3:6 Using 40 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

Providing  and  laying  in  position  Cement  Concrete   for  all  Sub  structures  of building,  Irrigation  works,  Sub  structure  works  of  bridges,  Drain  works    & other  parallel  works  from  0.50m  to  3.50  m  height.  The  granite/trap/basalt crushed  graded  coarse  aggregates    and  fine  aggregates    as  per  relevant  IS Codes machine mixed with super plasticisers,   laid in layers, well compacted using needle   vibrators, providing weep holes wherever necessary, including all lead & lifts,  cost of all materials of quality, confirming to the requirements of   relevant IS codes, labour, Usage charges of machinery, curing and all other appurtenances required to complete the work as per technical specifications. - M 20   Design Mix Using 20 mm nominal size graded crushed coarse  aggregates ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

Steel Fabrication
Supplying,   fitting   and   placing   TMT   FE   550   /   550D   Steel   Reinforcement including  cost  of  all  materials,  machinery,  labour,  cleaning,  straightening, cutting, bending, hooking, laping/welding joints, tying with binding wire / soft annealed steel wire and other ancilary operations complete as per drawing and technical specification. All other type of structures ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

Providing   and   fixing   Chlorinated   Polyvinyl   Chloride   (CPVC)   pipes, having thermal stability for hot & cold water supply including all CPVC plain & brass threaded fittings This includes jointing of pipes & fittings with one step CPVC solvent cement, trenching, refilling & testing of joints complete as per direction of Engineer in Charge. External work - 65 mm nominal dia Pipes ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

itemList.description: Surface Drains in Soil - Construction  of    unlined  surface  drains  of  average  cross- sectional  area  0.40  m2  in  soil  to  specified  lines,  grades, levels  and  dimensions.  Excavated  material  to  be  used  in embankment with a lift upto 3m and lead of 50 m (average lead 25 m) as per Technical Specification Clause 307. - Mechanical Means. Ref to MoRT&H : IRC - 307 ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

Providing and laying 100mm thick pre-cast cover slabs over Road side drains / utility ducts / Rain water harvesting pit of width not exceeding 1000 mm using M20 concrete reinforced with TMT bars Fe 550 @ 6kg/ m2,  slabs  jointed  in  CM  1:3  proportion  and  nicely  finished   Including providing holes in the Cover slabs wherever necessary for easy drain- age of surface water including of labour, materials,  scaffolding, usage of machinery, curing, lead and lift charges etc, Complete. ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading

Pavement Quality M30 grade Concrete (RMC) with OPC & GGBS laid using Paver Construction of M30 Grade un-reinforced, dowel jointed, plain cement concrete pavement over a prepared sub base with OPC @ 270 kg/m3 and GGBS@ 90 kg/m3, coarse and fine aggregate conforming to IS 383:2016, maximum size of coarse aggregate not exceeding 25 mm, mixed in a batching and mixing plant as per approved mix design transported to site, laid with a paver finisher, spread, compacted and finished in a continuous operation including provision of contraction, expansion, construction and longitudinal joints, joint filler, separation membrane, sealant primer, joint sealant, debonding strip, dowel bar, tie rod, admixtures, curing compound, steel channels, finishing to lines and grades as per drawing. ---- Including cost and conveyance of all materials, all labour, all lead and lifts, loading
